headline: FirstCry Operator Brainbees Surges 13% as Analysts Predict Margin Gain
summary: Shares of FirstCry operator Brainbees Solutions jumped 13% to nearly 179 rupees on the NSE, reaching a one-month high as JM Financial forecasted a sharp operating margin recovery in the ongoing third quarter.
why: Brainbees Solutions operates FirstCry, India's leading specialized omnichannel retailer for baby, children, and maternity products.

impacts.name: Brainbees Solutions
impacts.why: Analyst projections of an impending third-quarter operating margin turnaround triggered institutional buying.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Shares surged 13% after brokerage analysis highlighted expected margin recovery following second-quarter earnings.
